response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb, AVG(CAST(l.UN AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX) SELECT SEX, avg_alb, avg_ratio, avg_alb - (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM sex_averages) AS alb_above_mean FROM sex_averages WHERE avg_alb > (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM sex_averages);

assumptions.assumption: A test's UN/T-BIL ratio cannot be computed when T-BIL is zero or either value is missing.
